card.name: Warning section headings in labels
card.fires_on: Words inside warning headings of drug labels, such as 'Secondary' in 'Secondary Malignancies', the comma in 'Gastrointestinal Bleeding, Ulceration', and 'cause' in 'All-Cause Mortality'.
